River ice in the Himalayas.

The icy river threads between snow-lined banks beneath snowy Himalayan peaks. This quiet winter valley looks made for a slow mountain walk.

caption:
Low cloud over the conifers.

Frosted evergreens climb the snowy slope and a misty mountain ridge fades from view. I'd take this quiet winter forest trail slowly.

caption:
Milky Way over a snowy summit.

Green aurora spills across the night above a sharp alpine peak. No town lights, just stars and a quiet valley.

I'd stay up for this snowy mountain night. Save this alpine nightscape.
alt_text: A snowy mountain beneath the Milky Way and a green aurora.

caption:
Pink light on the ridgeline.

Alpenglow colors the snowy mountain summit while blue shadow spreads across the valley. I'd wait through the cold afternoon for this sunset.

alt_text: Pink-orange sunset light reaches a snowy mountain ridgeline.

caption:
Green aurora on still water.

A frozen mountain lake reflects snowy peaks and a sky full of stars. The shoreline looks silent beneath the winter night.

alt_text: Green aurora and stars reflect across a lake below snowy mountains.

caption:
Cobalt sky, white mountain layers.

Clear winter light picks out each ridgeline across these snowy mountain peaks. I'd take the longer trail for a view like this.

alt_text: A bright blue sky above layers of snow-covered mountain peaks.

caption:
Fresh snow reaches the summit.

Evergreen trees fill the foreground while warm light catches a high alpine mountain peak. A crisp winter morning like this makes me want to lace up and go.

caption:
The ridge disappears into cloud.
